import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create a DataFrame from the given dataset
data = {
    "Person ID": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    "Gender": ["Male", "Male", "Male", "Male", "Male"],
    "Age": [27, 28, 28, 28, 28],
    "Occupation": ["Software Engineer", "Doctor", "Doctor", "Sales Representative", "Sales Representative"],
    "Sleep Duration": [6.1, 6.2, 6.2, 5.9, 5.9],
    "Quality of Sleep": [6, 6, 6, 4, 4],
    "Physical Activity Level": [42, 60, 60, 30, 30],
    "Stress Level": [6, 8, 8, 8, 8],
    "BMI Category": ["Overweight", "Normal", "Normal", "Obese", "Obese"],
    "Blood Pressure": [126/83, 125/80, 125/80, 140/90, 140/90],
    "Heart Rate": [77, 75, 75, 85, 85],
    "Daily Steps": [4200, 10000, 10000, 3000, 3000],
    "Sleep Disorder": ["", "", "Sleep Apnea", "Sleep Apnea", "Sleep Apnea"]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert categorical columns to categorical type
df["Gender"] = df["Gender"].astype("category")
df["Occupation"] = df["Occupation"].astype("category")
df["BMI Category"] = df["BMI Category"].astype("category")
df["Sleep Disorder"] = df["Sleep Disorder"].astype("category")

# Plot a bar chart for each categorical column
fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))

sns.barplot(x="Gender", y="Sleep Duration", data=df, ax=axs[0, 0])
sns.barplot(x="Occupation", y="Daily Steps", data=df, ax=axs[0, 1])
sns.barplot(x="BMI Category", y="Heart Rate", data=df, ax=axs[0, 2])
sns.barplot(x="Sleep Disorder", y="Sleep Duration", data=df, ax=axs[1, 0])
sns.barplot(x="Stress Level", y="Heart Rate", data=df, ax=axs[1, 1])
sns.barplot(x="Physical Activity Level", y="Daily Steps", data=df, ax=axs[1, 2])

# Remove axes
for ax in axs.flat:
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    ax.yaxis.tick_right()
    ax.yaxis.set_label_position("right")
    ax.set_xticklabels(ax.get_xticklabels(), rotation=90)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)

# Layout so plots do not overlap
fig.tight_layout()

# Save the plot
plt.savefig("output.png")
